title: Concept: Laravel Horizon dashboard disclosed
description: Horizon renders failed job payloads with their arguments and the queue topology of the deployment. It also carries the controls that retry or delete those jobs, so the page is both a disclosure and a state-changing surface.
applicability: Responses from a Laravel application that mounts Horizon without an authorisation gate.
risk: The caller reads failed job arguments and can retry or delete jobs, changing application state.
